text:
alex: Quick sync — planning a staggered canary for the /v2/generate endpoint Thursday 11:30 UTC. Plan: 1% (30m, US‑EAST) -> 5% (30m, US only) -> 25% (60m global). Who can own deploy, smoke verification, and rollback? Any conflicting deploy windows?

maria: I can own smoke verification. I'll run the synthetic prompt set and check latency + 5xx. Will post results in-thread. :ok_hand:

sanjay: I can be deploy owner. I'm available 11:15-12:45 UTC. Will kick off the canary and watch rollout steps.

alex: Awesome — assigning sanjay for deploy. maria for smoke. emily can you take the monitoring/alert triage?

emily: Yep — I'll watch SLO dashboards and set a focused alert: p95 > 350ms OR error rate > 0.5% for the route. If we hit either, call for immediate rollback. I'll also enable a short-lived grafana share.

lisa: Suggest we limit first two slices to US-EAST only to reduce blast radius. Also confirm Dedicated pool usage — reserve slot 42 for the window.

sanjay: Agreed on US-EAST for 1% and 5%. I'll annotate the deploy with that constraint.

alex: Smoke test checklist (maria, feel free to reuse):
```
# quick smoke script (example)
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v2/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"Say hi","max_tokens":20}' | jq '.'
# check for HTTP 5xx and parse latency from headers or response
```

maria: I'll add a small harness that runs the above against the canary IPs and asserts: no 5xx, mean latency < 300ms, sample outputs pass quality checks. Will post results 11:40 and 12:10.

emily: For escalation, if (5xx > 0.5%) or (p95 gets above 400ms) within a 5m window, we'll stop ramping and consider rollback.

alex: Rollback plan (keeps simple): abort ramp, route traffic back to model v1 and scale down the new variant. Commands (ops-only):
```
# abort & route back to v1 (example)
deployctl abort --deployment canary-2026-03-19-1130
routectl set /v2/generate --model v1 --force
# or fallback using gateway tag
rollbackctl promote --service gateway --tag v1
```

sanjay: I have those commands ready. I'll also hold a quick phone dial if we need a manual rollback.

lisa: FYI - tickets for Dedicated slot reservation and quota bump are approved. No billing blockers.

alex: Deploy-bot, please schedule the job with owner=sanjay, smoke_owner=maria, monitor=emily, window=2026-03-19T11:30:00Z.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: canary deploy /v2/generate on 2026-03-19T11:30:00Z (owner: sanjay). Cohorts: 1% (US‑EAST) -> 5% (US) -> 25% (global). Smoke owner: maria. Rollback command prepped. Link runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/v2-canary.

alex: Perfect. maria — drop the smoke script links here when you have them; emily — I'll ping you 10m before start to ensure alerts are live. :thumbsup:

maria: Will do, posting harness link in 15m.

emily: Alerts ready. I'll also mute noncritical noise for the window.

sanjay: All set on my side. I'll start the sequence and update status every step in this thread.

alex: Thanks team — quiet rollout expected but we'll be standing by. If anyone can't make the window, shout now.

lisa: No conflicts from infra. Good luck! :rocket:
